# Support

Start with the [README](../README.md) for setup and usage, then check [Troubleshooting](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

For reproducible bugs, use this repository's **Issues** tab and the bug report form. Include your operating system, Python and discord.py-self versions, the command with sensitive values removed, and whether the failure happened during preview or copying.

Feature requests should explain the desired result and why the current supported copy scope is insufficient.

Never include tokens, private channel content, or unsanitized logs. For security vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
